Show less Read more Like Dislike Reply Comments 22 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam In this video Transcript Description Live: SpaceX launches Falcon 9 rocket with 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral, Florida Watch live coverage as SpaceX launches a Falcon 9 rocket carrying 29 satellites for Elon Musk's Starlink internet service. Liftoff from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is scheduled for Sunday, March 22, at 10:47 a.m. EDT (1447 UTC). The first-stage booster for this mission, 1078, launching for a 27th time, will land on SpaceX's drone ship 'A Shortfall of Gravitas', stationed in the Atlantic Ocean, roughly 8.5 minutes after leaving the launch pad. The mission, designated Starlink 10-62, will take a north-easterly trajectory on departure from Florida's Space Coast. Our live coverage with commentary from Spaceflight Now's Will Robinson-Smith will start about one hour prior to launch. Videos like this are made possible by the support of our members.
